page_title: BOL 0-1 JUV | Bologna v Juventus 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Lois Openda (Juventus) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
90+4' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+4' Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
90+2' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+1' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lois Openda (Juventus) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Federico Ravaglia pulls off a brilliant save.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' What was Ibrahim Sulemana (Bologna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
88' Substitution. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) replaces Francisco Conceicao.
87' Juan Miranda (Bologna) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
84' The shots on goal statistics – 4:2.
83' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Michele Di Gregorio as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
81' Here is a change. Jhon Lucumi is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
80' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
80' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
76' Here comes a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners is given a rest as he is replaced by Bremer (Juventus).
72' A substitution has been made. Nadir Zortea is replaced by Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
72' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Nikola Moro and he is replaced by Emil Holm (Bologna).
71' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
70' A free kick on the edge of the box for Juventus. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
69' We have witnessed a red card for Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna).
66' A substitution has been made. Thijs Dallinga goes off and Santiago Castro (Bologna) comes on.
65' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Lewis Ferguson will be replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Bologna).
64' 0 - 1 Goal! Juan Cabal (Juventus) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header low in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Kenan Yildiz.
64' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
64' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
63' Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Luciano Spalletti prepares a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Juan Cabal (Juventus).
60' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
60' Substitution. Lois Openda (Juventus) has come on for Jonathan David.
59' Surely that's handball by one of the Juventus players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
58' The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
57' The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
55' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
52' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Davide Massa blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Crossbar! Nadir Zortea (Bologna) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Federico Ravaglia displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
41' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' The goal by Juventus is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
37' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Davide Massa is going to take a look using VAR.
36' Jonathan David (Juventus) has a goal ruled out for offside!
33' Jonathan David (Juventus) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
30' The percentage of ball possession is – 53:47.
28' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
26' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
25' Juventus have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
24' Juan Miranda (Bologna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
21' Bologna take a short corner kick.
19' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
17' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
10' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
9' Some great controlled play and passing from Juventus. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

5' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Michele Di Gregorio shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
5' Bologna are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
3' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bologna.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa is the one to supervise the game today.
